design_archetype.style: Modern Neomorphic Glass & Tactical Crimson Accent
design_archetype.concept: Panze Studio-inspired floating frosted dashboard card resting on a deep slate gradient aura, paired with Bytespace-inspired dual-panel 3D login hero. Crisp high-contrast red accents (#E63946 / #DC2626) to emphasize government authority, precision performance metrics, and modern Indonesian civic identity.

universal_guidelines.data_testid: ALL interactive components, inputs, links, buttons, table headers, filter badges, and charts MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='kpi-capaian-donut-chart', data-testid='filter-periode-select').
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure min 4.5:1 text contrast. Primary action buttons must use red shadow glows, clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500 focus:outline-none).
universal_guidelines.footer: Include Design & Develop by MaiHarta linking to https://www.maiharta.com in all footers.
